extName.description: Shown by Firefox itself, in about:addons and on the add-on's listing. The name is a proper noun and is here to be transliterated, not translated.

extDescription.message: A free, modern, open-source and highly customizable visual bookmark manager and start page for your browser.

empty_inGroup.message: Nothing in this group yet - drag a tile onto its name to put it here.

empty_noTiles.message: No tiles yet. Hit + to add your first bookmark.

empty_noTilesNoAdd.message: No tiles yet. Right-click anywhere to add your first bookmark.

tile_visits.description: $1 is how many times this site has been opened from here.

tile_sampleName.description: Standing in for a name while the sheet has no address typed in it yet.

group_all.description: The chip that clears the filter, and what its tooltip says.

group_chipTitle.message:
$1
Drag to reorder, right-click to rename or delete
group_chipTitle.description: $1 is the group's name. The line break is deliberate: a tooltip's second line says what can be done to it.

group_sheetNote.message: Tiles are added to a group by dragging them onto it.

group_full.message: That is as many groups as there is room for ($1).
group_full.description: $1 is the most groups there is room for.

group_untitled.description: What a group with no usable name of its own is called.

tile_sheetNote.message: The icon is fetched automatically as you type the address.

tile_optional.description: Marks a field that may be left empty. Shown after the field's own name.

tile_iconPlaceholder.message: Web address, or paste a picture or SVG

tile_iconReload.message: Look up the site's own icon again

tile_iconHelp.message: Press $1 to choose a file, or paste a picture or its SVG code anywhere in this sheet.
tile_iconHelp.description: $1 is the button that chooses a file, drawn as its icon.

tile_iconColorClear.message: Back to the icon's own colours

tile_bgTitle.description: The name the colour picker gives itself when it opens on a tile.

icon_noneDeep.message: This site has no icon — choose or paste a picture instead.

icon_noneShallow.message: The usual lookup found nothing. Try switching on Deep icon lookup in Settings.

icon_found.description: $1 is the icon's width in pixels, in all three. Three messages rather than one with a tail: each is a whole sentence to be re-ordered freely.

icon_foundLargest.message: Found a $1px icon, the highest resolution there was to find.

icon_foundSmall.message: Found a $1px icon. Try switching on Deep icon lookup in Settings to find a larger one.

icon_needAddress.message: Fill in the site's address first.

icon_cleared.message: The icon that was set has been cleared.
icon_cleared.description: Added after whichever of the above the lookup ended with.

icon_cannotKeep.message: The icon could not be downloaded. Try choosing a file, or pasting one from the clipboard.

icon_unreadable.message: The image could not be read — try choosing a file.

icon_clickToTake.message: Click the icon to pick a colour out of it.

tile_badUrl.message: That does not look like a web address…

icon_fileUnreadable.message: That file could not be read.

icon_fileTooLarge.message: That image is too large — pick a smaller one.

icon_svgNotCode.message: That does not look like SVG code…

icon_svgUnreadable.message: That SVG could not be read — it may be incomplete.

icon_svgTooLong.message: That SVG is too long to save.

confirm_deleteText.message: “$1” will be deleted from the page.

btn_export.description: The pair on the Backup row: one writes the file, the other reads one back.

busy_font.description: What a control says while it is busy, in place of its status line.

busy_resetting.message: Putting everything back to how it was…

shortcut_command.description: How the shortcut that opens the settings window is written down. The Apple one is a symbol and reads the same everywhere; the other names a key, and a keyboard in another language names it differently.

set_fontNote.message: Sets the font for the tile names, the date and the time.

set_settingsButtonNote.message: It can still be opened with $1 and from the right-click menu.
set_settingsButtonNote.description: $1 is the keyboard shortcut that opens this window.

set_backupNote.message: Export and import your tiles, groups and settings.

set_resetNote.message: Every setting goes back to its default; your tiles are kept.

set_backgroundNote.message: A local file, or a web address.

set_dimNote.message: Darkens the background for better readability.

set_columnsAuto.description: Names the bottom of the Columns slider, where a count would be nothing.

set_columnsNote.message: Auto fits as many per row as the window allows.

set_logoPadNote.message: The room left clear around a tile's icon.

set_showVisitsNote.message: Puts the number of times you have opened a site in the corner of its tile.

set_showAddButtonNote.message: A + is shown at the end of the grid for adding a site.

set_openInNewTab.message: Open sites in a new tab

set_deepIconsNote.message: Reads a site's markup for its sharpest logo. Firefox permission is required.

set_timeNote.message: The exact shape follows your browser's language.

set_matchPageFont.description: The card at the head of the clock's and the date's font pickers: no family of their own, follow the one the page is set in.

set_headerTintNote.message: With it off, the colour follows the theme.

set_showAllGroupNote.message: The group that holds every saved page from all groups.

set_showGroupAddNote.message: The + at the end of the bar. Right-clicking the page also makes one.

set_keepGroupNote.message: The start page opens on the group that was open last.

set_groupScrollNote.message: A mouse scroll or a trackpad gesture changes the group.

about_blurb.message: A free, modern, open-source and highly customizable visual bookmark manager and start page for your browser.

about_sourceNote.message: The source code, the community, and where to report bugs.

color_blue.description: The ten macOS accents, then five whites and five blacks. Names for the ear rather than exact colour words - what a reader would call them.

bg_empty.message: Drop an image or video here, or choose a file.

bg_localFile.description: What a picture chosen from this computer is called when it has no name.

bg_tooWide.message: This image is wider than the window, so its position cannot be changed.

bg_dragIt.message: Drag it with the mouse, or use the arrow keys.

bg_useAgain.description: $1 is the picture's name, or `bg_thisOne` where it has none.

bg_fileUnreadable.message: That file could not be read.

bg_pictureTooBig.message: That picture is $1 — the limit is $2. Pick a smaller one.
bg_pictureTooBig.description: $1 is the file's size, $2 the largest allowed - both already in words.

bg_pictureNoRoom.message: That image is too large to store, even shrunk down.

bg_videoTooBig.message: That video is $1 — the limit is $2. Pick a shorter or smaller one.

bg_videoUnplayable.message: The browser cannot play that video.

bg_slowAddress.message: The address took too long to answer.

bg_nothingThere.message: Nothing could be loaded — is it really an image or a video?

bg_needsHttp.message: That needs to be a web address starting http:// or https://.

bg_noRoom.message: There was no room left to store that background.

bg_untitled.description: The name a picture with none of its own is filed under.

bg_droppedOff.message: That one has dropped off the list.

bg_setByAddress.message: Background set. That address would not let its image be downloaded, so it is fetched again every time.

bg_setRemembered.message: Background set, with its settings restored.

bg_setDimmed.message: Set — turn Dim down to see more of it.

font_filterAll.description: The first button of either filter: no filter at all.

font_scriptLatinExtTitle.message: Extended Latin - accents and the rest of Europe

font_system.description: The card at the head of the page font's picker: no family at all.

font_noneMatch.message: No family in the list covers both of those.

font_previewsOffline.message: Drawing the fonts for the first time needs a connection.

font_loaded.description: $1 is the family, $2 where it came from - one of the four below.

font_googleReplied.description: $1 is the HTTP status Google Fonts answered with.

font_noSuchFamily.message: Google Fonts has no family called "$1".
font_noSuchFamily.description: $1 is the family that was asked for.

font_noFiles.message: Could not download the font files.

font_tooLarge.message: That font is too large to cache.

font_noPreviews.message: Could not download the font previews.

perm_notInstalled.message: Only available once the add-on is installed in Firefox.

perm_hint.message: You can also switch on "Access your data for all websites" under about:addons → Tiles → Permissions.
perm_hint.description: The way in that does not go through this toggle. Added to both refusals below, so it is written once.

perm_refused.description: $1 is the reason Firefox gave, $2 is perm_hint.

perm_deepOn.message: Every site is now examined for a high-resolution icon.

perm_deepOff.message: Back to the conventional ways of finding icons.

backup_saved.description: $1 is the name the file was saved under.

backup_fileUnreadable.message: That file could not be read.

backup_tooLarge.message: That file is too large to be a backup.

backup_notABackup.message: This add-on cannot read that backup file.

backup_empty.message: That backup is empty — there is nothing in it to restore.

backup_stopped.description: $1 is whatever went wrong, in the browser's own words.

restore_done.description: $1 is a list of what came back - "3 groups, 12 tiles and your settings".

restore_doneFrom.description: $2 is the add-on the file was written by.

restore_pictureRefused.message: The background image would not fit, so the old one was kept.

restore_lost.message: It also held $1, which this add-on has nowhere to keep.
restore_lost.description: $1 is a list, the same shape as restore_done's.

restore_lostStats.message: the time-of-day split behind the visit counts

restore_tile.description: One tile, and more than one. See `plural` below.

list_and.description: Joining a list of the above. $1 is everything but the last, already joined by `list_comma`; $2 is the last one.
